system.description: Whether from residual religious guilt or from taking vampire legends too seriously, the sight of a cross drives you to flee unless you spend a Willpower Trait, in which case you resist it for the rest of the scene. If a cross touches your bare skin you take one level of aggravated damage per blow, which Fortitude cannot reduce. This applies to an actual religious symbol, not two crossed sticks.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
